reconcile.note: Gill reconciles the differing time markers by noting the women set out while it was still dark and reached the tomb only as the sun was rising.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Wells argues the Gospels flatly disagree on timing: John places the women's arrival while it was still dark, while Matthew and Mark put it at dawn or after sunrise.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: they came to the tomb when the sun had risen
sides.verseText: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

sides.snippet: went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb
sides.verseText: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.
